description: Label taxonomy of the ragentic-io/manifests catalog. Keys and values follow Kubernetes label syntax. Documented in TAXONOMY.md; enforced by label.py and by Ragentic's catalog filters (selector syntax).

category.description: Primary category: one id from catalog/categories.json.

vendor.description: Company or project behind the API, as a lowercase slug (stripe, google, apache). Not enumerated; must match value_pattern.

protocol.description: API description format of the bundle. Set from the bundle, never by the model.

auth.description: How a connection authenticates. From setup.credential when the bundle has one, else from the definition's security schemes.

capability.description: What the API lets a connection do. Several allowed: each is its own key capability.<value> with the value "true".

provides.description: The one job a coworker's need asks this app for: Ragentic offers the app on the Connect card for a need that provides the same (docs/filling-gaps.md in ragentic-io/ragentic). One value; omit when no single job fits.

region.description: Only when the API serves one jurisdiction or market (a national government API, a regional bank). Omit for global services.

compliance.description: Only when the API itself exists for a regulated domain (open banking -> psd2, health records -> hipaa). Omit otherwise; never inferred from a vendor's certifications.

pricing.description: How the provider charges for API access. Omit when unknown.

maturity.description: Catalog state: published or draft. Set from the listing's catalog field, never by the model.
